title: System update/user route resilience + default update URL (SYS-17 follow-up)
acceptance_criteria: System Update Check page no longer hard-fails with `Not Found` when runtime status endpoint is absent; it shows an unavailable warning state.
System Users page continues to load local-user CRUD even if global login config endpoint is unavailable.
Update Check URL field is pre-populated by default with the VyOS nightly version JSON URL while auto-check remains disabled by default.
Frontend validation and smoke gates pass after runtime restart.
assumptions: Route-level 404 with message `Not Found` indicates backend version/process mismatch rather than data-path failure.
Fallback behavior should preserve critical workflows (local users, status visibility) without changing backend API contracts.

tasks.notes: Changed load flow to allSettled, isolated login-config availability, and preserved local-user operations.
Set default update URL form value while keeping auto-check disabled by default.
Restarted vm-api/vm-ui and passed tsc, eslint (0 errors), build, smoke:runtime, smoke:ui.
Continue partial-backlog implementation sweep before verification pass.
